context:
Training Gym R54 completed! ALL 4 CLEAN ON FIRST TRY!

R54 RESULTS (all 10/10, all clean):
1. trie-001 (T5) - Trie with insert/search/startsWith/delete. Dict-based nodes, cleanup on delete.
2. union-find-001 (T6) - Union-Find with path compression + union by rank. Count tracking.
3. kmp-001 (T7) - KMP with LPS failure function build. O(n+m) matching.
4. lca-binary-lifting-001 (T8) - Binary lifting LCA. BFS for depth, up[][] table, O(log n) query.

DB: 267 exercises, 455 attempts, avg 9.88, 94.3% perfect.
203 exercises passed. 19+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.

Key algorithms learned:
- Trie: dict children + is_end. Delete: track path, cleanup bottom-up when !is_end and !children
- Union-Find: parent=self, rank=0. find with recursive path compression. union by rank with count tracking
- KMP: LPS build: len tracks prefix length. On mismatch, fall back to lps[len-1]. Search: skip via lps on mismatch
- LCA binary lifting: up[k][v] = 2^k ancestor. Lift deeper node to same depth, then lift both simultaneously
decisions: Trie delete: collect path nodes, mark is_end=False, cleanup bottom-up while !is_end and !children
Union-Find: always point lower rank to higher, increment rank only when equal
KMP LPS: when mismatch and len>0, set len=lps[len-1] without incrementing i
LCA: up[0][root]=root, lift by checking (diff>>k)&1 bits, then lift both from LOG down to 0
next_steps: Design R55 exercises. Try: Heap/Priority Queue from scratch, Sparse Table for RMQ, Aho-Corasick with dict trie, or Splay Tree.
